test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Quant (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
The following pie charts show the data of the number of appeared and passed students of class 12 in sections A, B, C, D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f91ad4812e6e2595ff3b6b8f04d56e2a6aa28a9e8382e2c210da104e3f2aa6f6.png] 

Find the difference between the number of students who appeared for the exam in sections A and B
solution:
**Given:**

Total appeared students = 1800

Angle for section A = 42°

Angle for section B = 50°

**Formula used:**

Number of students in a section = (Angle / 360°) × Total students

**Calculations:**

Number of students in section A = (42 / 360) × 1800 = 210

Number of students in section B = (50 / 360) × 1800 = 250

Difference = 250 - 210 = 40

**∴ The difference between the number of students who appeared for the exam in sections A and B is 40.**
